newsitem.title: USA: Cadmus sells consumer publishing unit.
newsitem.headline: Cadmus sells consumer publishing unit.

text.p: Cadmus Communications Corp said on Monday it sold its Cadmus Consumer Publishing Division to Landmark Specialty Publications, a unit of Landmark Communications Inc.
The division sells price guides for sports and entertainment card collectors, Cadmus said in a statement.
The sale price was not disclosed, and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Cadmus Chairman, President and Chief Executive C. Stephenson Gillispie Jr. said consumer publishing was no longer a core part of the company's strategy.

"This transaction allows us to focus our resources and our attention on our core businesses and also generate cash which we will use to reduce the debt we incurred when we acquired Lancaster Information Group earlier this year," he said.
Gillispie said the transaction would not have a material impact on the company's operating results or growth.
